title: Ownership benefits and missing handbook items
summary: This topic loosely groups ownership-related comments, including owner satisfaction, missing owner’s handbook delivery, and expectations around optional extras and subscription benefits.

positive.summary: Positive feedback is limited to a brief expression of owner happiness.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention being an owner, enthusiasm about purchase, delayed handbook delivery, and views on first-owner benefits and optional extras without enough context for a clear sentiment assignment.

limitations: The cluster mixes several loosely related subjects such as owner identity, purchase enthusiasm, handbook delivery, subscription benefits, and optional equipment.
Most examples are assigned undetermined sentiment, so the available evidence for clear opinion patterns is limited.
The sampled fragments are brief and often lack enough context to determine whether some ownership and optional-extra comments are favorable or unfavorable.
